summary: W3 Index Lifecycle and Exact-Threshold Baseline: prove DT-05 threshold-all correctness before ANN performance comparison, make DT-16 all-mutation lifecycle/version evidence complete for the semantic index, and reject DT-17 unaligned pure semantic queries while preserving canonical reads.

explicitEntrypoints.controlPoint: Run threshold-all seed retrieval against many-peer relevant, unrelated, and ANN comparison fixtures across Element, ArchitectureRelationship, and View channels.
explicitEntrypoints.observationPoint: Observe every above-threshold peer returned per channel, zero unrelated forced hits, no fixed result limit, and ANN top-k marked performance-only rather than correctness baseline.

explicitEntrypoints.controlPoint: Run the canonical mutation matrix for create, update, delete, topology-only, semantic-content, and View-membership changes.
explicitEntrypoints.observationPoint: Observe all nine mutation classes, version advancement, deleted-object absence, non-Aligned partial persistence, and affected-record lifecycle evidence.

explicitEntrypoints.controlPoint: Inspect semantic-index records produced by the DT-16 mutation matrix for affected Element, ArchitectureRelationship, and View records.
explicitEntrypoints.observationPoint: Observe object identity, channel, canonical/content/index version, provider, model, model version, and dimensions evidence for every indexed record.

explicitEntrypoints.controlPoint: Submit canonical-read controls and a pure semantic request while the semantic index is unaligned.
explicitEntrypoints.observationPoint: Observe full and explicit-anchor canonical reads remain available, pure semantic requests fail with SEMANTIC_INDEX_NOT_ALIGNED, and no automatic full-snapshot fallback occurs.

criticalNonExplicitTests.name: W3 production Graph RAG boundary contract
criticalNonExplicitTests.controlPoint: Inspect root, local Graph RAG, and test contracts for W3 threshold-all, lifecycle, and alignment responsibilities.
criticalNonExplicitTests.observationPoint: Contracts expose selectThresholdAllSeeds(request), generateAffectedEmbeddings(input), evaluateSemanticAlignment(request), and W3 frozen entrypoint ownership.

criticalNonExplicitTests.name: W3 production dependency direction
criticalNonExplicitTests.controlPoint: Inspect production Graph RAG JavaScript modules for outward test dependencies, Python/runtime sidecars, child_process ownership, and Neo4j plugin calls.
criticalNonExplicitTests.observationPoint: Production code remains inward-facing; only the approved system metadata adapter may own system commands, and semantic/index delivery does not depend on tests or plugin embedding procedures.

criticalNonExplicitTests.name: W3 explicit entrypoint correctness
criticalNonExplicitTests.controlPoint: Inspect DT-05, DT-16, DT-16-SemanticIndex, and DT-17 physical entrypoints plus the handoff frozen-file list.
criticalNonExplicitTests.observationPoint: Entrypoints retain GIVEN/WHEN/THEN readability, Harness abstraction, and key DT-05/DT-16/DT-17 business failure categories.

criticalNonExplicitTests.name: W3 implementation traceability
criticalNonExplicitTests.controlPoint: Inspect intent anchors, root implements mappings, mounted testcase paths, and physical entrypoint files.
criticalNonExplicitTests.observationPoint: grag-seed-retrieval, grag-semantic-index, grag-index-lifecycle, and grag-alignment-constraint remain mapped to their W3 entrypoints.

codingTargets.nextAction: Expose threshold-all seed selection evidence per object channel and treat ANN top-k only as performance comparison.
Return independent Element, ArchitectureRelationship, and View seed channels with all peers at or above their approved thresholds.
Implement all-mutation affected-record lifecycle sequencing and expose complete version advancement evidence.
Persist complete semantic-index evidence fields for affected Element, ArchitectureRelationship, and View records after successful canonical mutation work.
Reject unaligned pure semantic queries with SEMANTIC_INDEX_NOT_ALIGNED while leaving no-argument and explicit canonical-anchor reads available.
Expose semantic alignment evaluation before seed retrieval and report non-Aligned lifecycle states without serving stale semantic context or silently falling back.

taskExecutionPlan.executionStrategy: Implement W3 in dependency order: first lifecycle state and affected-record evidence, then threshold-all seed correctness, then unaligned query rejection. Do not modify frozen explicit entrypoints or critical guards. Completion requires DT-05, DT-16, DT-16-SemanticIndex, DT-17, and the four W3 critical guards to pass, with no new delivered-to-not_delivered regression beyond runner-owned baseline updates.

tasks.title: Implement lifecycle evidence baseline
tasks.objective: Make every canonical mutation class advance affected-record semantic-index version evidence or leave the index non-Aligned.
steps: Define the nine mutation classes observed by the frozen entrypoint.
Extract only affected Element, ArchitectureRelationship, and View records after successful canonical mutation work.
Persist object identity, channel, canonical/content/index version, provider, model, model version, and dimensions evidence.
Set Aligned only after complete persistence; partial or failed persistence reports Updating, Stale, or Failed.
tasks.completionSignal: runMutationIndexLifecycle.js passes for both DT-16 and DT-16-SemanticIndex and no semantic-index record lacks version/model evidence.

tasks.title: Implement threshold-all seeds
tasks.objective: Make threshold-all the Phase 1 correctness baseline before ANN comparison.
steps: Return independent seed channels for Element, ArchitectureRelationship, and View.
Return every peer whose score is at or above the channel threshold.
Report zero forced hits for unrelated queries.
Report ANN top-k only under performance comparison evidence and never as correctness evidence.
tasks.completionSignal: runIndependentSemanticSeeds.js includes all above-threshold peer IDs, no fixed result limit, zero unrelated forced hits, and annComparison.correctnessRole equals performance-only.

tasks.title: Implement alignment rejection
tasks.objective: Reject unaligned pure semantic queries while preserving canonical read paths.
steps: Evaluate semantic-index alignment before invoking seed retrieval for pure semantic requests.
Return SEMANTIC_INDEX_NOT_ALIGNED for Updating, Stale, Failed, partial, or unknown states.
Set fullSnapshotFallback to false for rejected pure semantic requests.
Preserve no-argument full snapshot reads and explicit canonical-anchor reads.
tasks.completionSignal: runStaleSemanticQueryRejection.js passes with SEMANTIC_INDEX_NOT_ALIGNED, no automatic fallback, and both canonical-read controls passing.

tasks.title: Verify W3 completion
tasks.objective: Prove W3 acceptance and guardrail completion against the pre-coding baseline.
steps: Run the four frozen W3 explicit entrypoints.
Run the four W3 critical non-explicit guards.
Run the full architecture test runner and compare deliveryStatus changes to the pre-coding baseline.
Commit only authorized Coding targets and runner-owned baseline updates.
tasks.completionSignal: DT-05, DT-16, DT-16-SemanticIndex, DT-17, and the four W3 critical guards pass with zero new delivered-to-not_delivered regression.

openGaps: No intent graph mutation is required; W3 testcase boundaries and release gates are already present in the validated intent handoff.

DT-05 and DT-04 share the physical entrypoint mounted by the intent graph. DT-05 assertions are explicit in that frozen file, and any future split should be proposed upstream rather than edited directly here.
Runner-owned deliveryStatus and test-failure-record updates remain governed by the full architecture runner and are not manually fabricated.
